eventos.texto: Good morning, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Hello, I'd like the earliest gynaecology appointment.
Entiende cuándo la quiere: lo antes posible
Could I take your full name, and either your DNI or NIE, or the phone number on your file?
Maria Garcia Lopez, born 12th of March 1984.
Ficha encontrada: María G. (por fecha de nacimiento y nombre)
Sin huecos en ginecología · frenados por regla: Dra. Isabel Morán (el seguro no cubre esa especialidad)
Thank you, María, I have your record here. Your Adeslas plan doesn't cover gynaecology. Do you have any other insurance I could use?
Regla de la casa: no había hueco
I'm sorry, I can't book that: there's nothing free that matches in the diary. Is there anything else I can help with?
Thank you for calling. Take care, goodbye.
